dimensions.assessment: Affects the Department of Veterans Affairs, the Comptroller General (GAO), and congressional committees receiving oversight reports.
dimensions.evidence: Comptroller General of the United States shall submit to the Committees on Veterans' Affairs of the Senate and the House of Representatives a report

dimensions.assessment: Modifies administrative and legal authorities for recovering and depositing funds into the Medical Care Collections Fund and requires regular auditing reports.
dimensions.evidence: improve the efficiency of the recovery and collection of revenue for the Department of Veterans Affairs Medical Care Collections Fund

dimensions.assessment: Affects the collection, recovery, and accounting of federal funds and reimbursements for medical care, services, and medications paid under chapter 17, though specific revenue totals are not projected.
dimensions.evidence: total amount of funds recovered or collected during the period covered by the report, disaggregated by source of recovery or collection

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38, United States Code, to add specific collection legal references, grant discretionary transfer authority to the Secretary, and mandate recurring GAO reporting.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1729A of title 38, United States Code, is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a temporary authority expiring on September 30, 2028, with GAO reports required every 180 days while the authority is effective.
dimensions.evidence: The authority of the Secretary to deposit amounts into the Medical Care Collections Fund pursuant to this subsection shall expire on September 30, 2028.

missing_information: Projected dollar amounts expected to be collected or recovered under the expanded authorities.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill expands the revenue recovery and collection authorities for the VA Medical Care Collections Fund through September 30, 2028, and mandates periodic GAO reports on the deposits and expenditures.
